subtitle.zh: 一本我们一起写的书，一次一篇反思。
subtitle.en: A book we are writing together, one reflection at a time.

intro.zh: 在改变任何事情之前，先学会看。
intro.en: Before we change anything, we learn to look.

prompts.zh: 今天我注意到了什么？
prompts.en: What did I notice today?

prompts.zh: 我还有什么不知道？
prompts.en: What do I still not know?

prompts.zh: 我想把什么带在身边？
prompts.en: What do I want to carry with me?

intro.zh: 放慢一些，再看一遍我们看见的。
intro.en: Looking again, more slowly, at what we saw.

prompts.zh: 我对你有了什么新的理解？
prompts.en: What did I come to understand about you?

prompts.zh: 我对自己有了什么新的理解？
prompts.en: What did I come to understand about myself?

prompts.zh: 我们在哪里误解了彼此？误解底下是什么？
prompts.en: Where did we misunderstand each other, and what was underneath?

intro.zh: 那些从过去一路带来的规则与声音。
intro.en: The rules and voices we brought with us from before.

prompts.zh: 童年的哪些声音，仍在我做决定时开口？
prompts.en: Which voices from my childhood still speak when I decide?

prompts.zh: 哪些规则，是我没有选择就继承下来的？
prompts.en: Which rules did I inherit without choosing them?

prompts.zh: 哪个声音我想留下，哪个可以放下？
prompts.en: Which voice do I want to keep, and which can I set down?

intro.zh: 坦白地说出我们想要什么。

prompts.zh: 如果允许自己直说，我想要什么？
prompts.en: What do I want, if I let myself say it plainly?

prompts.zh: 我为我们想要什么？
prompts.en: What do I want for us?

prompts.zh: 如果把想要说出口，我害怕会发生什么？
prompts.en: What am I afraid will happen if I want it out loud?

intro.zh: 每一次选择，也是一次放下。
intro.en: Every choice is also a letting go.

prompts.zh: 我们在选择什么？
prompts.en: What are we choosing?

prompts.zh: 我们选择不做什么？
prompts.en: What are we choosing not to do?

prompts.zh: 什么会告诉我们，这个选择对不对？
prompts.en: What will tell us whether it was the right choice?

intro.zh: 试一件小事，留心会发生什么。
intro.en: Trying something small, and paying attention to what happens.

prompts.zh: 我们尝试了什么？
prompts.en: What did we try?

prompts.zh: 诚实地说，发生了什么？
prompts.en: What happened, honestly?

prompts.zh: 我们要保留、改变，还是放下什么？
prompts.en: What will we keep, change, or let go?

intro.en: Looking back over the whole road.

prompts.zh: 刚开始时，我是怎样的人？
prompts.en: Who was I when we began?

prompts.zh: 我们之间有了什么变化？
prompts.en: What has changed between us?

prompts.zh: 这段旅程里，我想记住什么？
prompts.en: What do I want to remember from this journey?
